title: Serum selenium, iron and rubidium are altered in treatment-resistant schizophrenia
title_zh: 血清硒、铁和锑在难治性精神分裂症中改变
abstract: Abstract The molecular basis of schizophrenia is complex, involving an interplay of genetic and environmental factors. In recent postmortem and imaging studies, we identified disturbances in iron homeostasis in cortical and subcortical regions of individuals with schizophrenia. These may be relevant to neuropathology identified in the disorder and could relate to mechanisms of oxidative stress and inflammation. Recent work has proposed that there is a dysregulation of brain metals and other elements in schizophrenia that might impact on oxidative stress. Using a metallomics approach, we report robust changes in serum levels of pro-oxidant iron, anti-oxidant selenium, and the potassium-marker, rubidium, in a cohort of people with treatment-resistant schizophrenia (TRS). The cohort also expressed elevated levels of serum pro-inflammatory cytokines and hepcidin, and lower levels of anti-oxidant selenoproteins, selenoprotein-P1 (SEPP1) and glutathione peroxidase 3 (GPX3). The changes in serum iron, rubidium and selenium discriminate between control individuals and TRS cases, and they were not affected by age or clozapine serum levels. We propose that the changes in selenium and cytokines might drive the expression of hepcidin, resulting in reduced serum iron levels. Further research should investigate the relationship between peripheral and central measures of these elements and their metabolism, and further explore the relevance of pro-oxidant stress to the neuropathology of schizophrenia.
abstract_zh: 摘要 精神分裂症的分子基础很复杂，涉及遗传和环境因素的相互作用。在最近的尸检和成像研究中，我们发现精神分裂症患者皮质和亚皮质区域铁稳态出现紊乱。这些可能与该疾病中鉴定出的神经病理学变化有关，并可能与氧化应激和炎症的机制相关。最近的研究提议，大脑金属和其他元素的调节失调可能与精神分裂症有关，并可能影响氧化应激。利用金属组学方法，我们在一组难治性精神分裂症（TRS）患者的血清中发现了氧化剂铁、抗氧化剂硒以及钾标记锑的稳健变化。该队列还表现出血清促炎细胞因子和铁蛋白升高，以及抗氧化硒蛋白硒蛋白P1（SEPP1）和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶3（GPX3）水平降低。血清铁、锑和硒的变化能够区分对照个体和TRS病例，且不受年龄或氯氮平血浓度的影响。我们推测，硒和细胞因子的变化可能驱动铁蛋白的表达，从而导致血清铁水平降低。进一步的研究应调查这些元素的外周和中心浓度及其代谢关系，并进一步探讨氧化应激与精神分裂症神经病理学的相关性。
